citation: He, Zhu, He & Lyu (2020), Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets towards Automated Log Analytics, arXiv:2008.06448
description: Drain-parsed event-template keys of 2000 real Hadoop HDFS log lines (LogHub HDFS_2k sample), in file order. Not anomaly-labelled: LogHub's block-level labels ship with the full HDFS_1 release.
license: LogHub datasets are released for research use; see the LogHub repository.
